rag.body: For the Midwest region operating on band n78, the maximum transmit power per cell SHALL NOT exceed 43 dBm without a Tier-3 RF engineering review and an interference budget reconciliation. Any change raising tx.maxPower beyond this threshold MUST be denied by the drift guard.

rag.body: Reducing electrical tilt while simultaneously raising transmit power compounds interference into adjacent cells. Combined adjustments to tilt and tx power within a single change require an interference simulation and explicit reviewer sign-off.
rag.highlight: Combined adjustments to tilt and tx power within a single change require an interference simulation

rag.body: Chicago metro n78 cells are deployed in a tight reuse pattern. The regional plan budgets ≤ 0.5 dB SINR loss per neighbor for any single change.
Power-affecting changes must be staged. Direct production OSS writes are forbidden during evaluation; the sandbox boundary will refuse the call.
rag.highlight: Direct production OSS writes are forbidden during evaluation
